coopMoney.card.title: Pay by card
coopMoney.card.description: Pay your member share by card through Stripe's secure checkout. You return here once it is paid, and your membership starts when the payment arrives.
coopMoney.card.pending: Your card checkout is still open. Continue it to pay, or let it expire.
coopMoney.card.refunds: Leaving the co-op does not refund your share by itself. A treasurer refunds it to your card when the bylaws say it is due.
coopMoney.card.failed: The checkout could not be started. Try again in a moment.
coopMoney.payouts.title: Payouts
coopMoney.payouts.description: Pay this period's patronage to each member. A second treasurer or an admin approves the payout before any payout row is created.
coopMoney.payouts.caption: Patronage payouts for this period
coopMoney.payouts.deleted: Account deleted. The amount stays owed.
coopMoney.payouts.empty.title: No payouts yet
coopMoney.payouts.empty.body: Payout rows appear once paying this period out is approved.
coopMoney.payouts.loadFailed: The payouts could not be loaded.
coopMoney.pay.title: Pay this period out?
coopMoney.pay.description: This asks for, or gives, the second approval. When it is approved, each member with an allocation gets one payout row. Members with a ready Stripe account are paid through Stripe; everyone else is paid by bank transfer, marked here.
coopMoney.pay.requested: Payout requested. A second treasurer or an admin must approve it.
coopMoney.pay.secondApprover: Someone other than the person who asked must approve this payout.
coopMoney.pay.notApproved: Only an approved period can be paid out.
coopMoney.markPaid.title: Mark this payout paid?
coopMoney.markPaid.description: Record the bank transfer you sent. This posts the payout to the ledger and cannot be undone.
coopMoney.markPaid.referenceHint: A short code with no spaces: letters, digits and . _ : / # -
coopMoney.mine.title: Your payout
coopMoney.mine.pending: Your payout of {amount} is on its way.
coopMoney.mine.failed: Your payout of {amount} did not go through. A treasurer will pay it another way.
coopMoney.mine.reversed: Your payout of {amount} came back. A treasurer will pay it again.
coopMoney.mine.none: Your payout for this period has not been sent yet.
